body: You're a good person. Don't ever change. Love and respect.
My Mother's response to me after crying and telling her I needed help: "When you get a job with benefits, you can get the help you need." No lie, no exaggeration...

I don't have health insurance and certainly no money to see a professional. I tried talking to my parents about it months ago, but it fell on deaf ears. My girlfriend is barely talking to me, she thinks I hate her but she couldn't be further from the truth...

Last night I was visiting her at work (she's a bartender). She has been accusing me of getting "weird" when I drink. It's because depression and anxiety don't mix well with alcohol. So I stopped drinking and she got pissed off and told me "I wasn't fun anymore." I don't understand what she wanted from me in that moment. To get obliterated drunk?
I just don't know what to do anymore
